title: Length of a query word
statement: Let $n_b$ be a natural number, let $b$ be a Boolean string of length $n_b$, and let $t,a,x$ be Boolean words. The query formed by concatenating $b$, the encodings of $t$ and $a$ separated by two zero bits, and then $x$ after two further zero bits has length $n_b+2|t|+2|a|+4+|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $b$ is a Boolean string indexed by $n_b$ positions
